name: Awesome Coming Soon & Maintenance Mode
author: iamaliiraja

sections.description:
Awesome Coming Soon & Maintenance Mode is a modern WordPress coming soon plugin built for launches, redesigns, and maintenance windows.

Launch faster with ready-made templates and customize everything from one settings panel: content, design, timer, newsletter, social links, contact info, access control, and SEO.

Whether you are building a startup website, client project, eCommerce store, agency landing page, or product teaser page, this plugin helps you keep visitors engaged while your site is in progress.

Live Demo Previews

  • Aurora demo
  • Loft demo
  • Blush demo
  • Glassline demo

Core Features

  • One-click coming soon / maintenance mode switch
  • Modern free templates included
  • Full content controls (Heading, Subheading, Message)
  • Countdown timer with launch date and time
  • Newsletter form with custom labels and consent checkbox
  • Social media links and contact details
  • Logo, favicon, footer text, and branding options
  • Design controls: accent color, heading color, text color, typography
  • Background modes: Image, Solid Color, Gradient
  • Access controls for logged-in users and role-based bypass options
  • SEO settings: title, description, robots, social sharing fields
  • Mobile-friendly and responsive layout
  • Fast, lightweight frontend output

Use Cases

  • Product launches and pre-launch pages
  • Website redesign / rebrand maintenance mode
  • Client website under construction pages
  • Agency handoff pages with lead capture
  • App waitlist pages with countdown and newsletter signup

Why Users Choose This Plugin

  • Fast setup and easy onboarding
  • Clean UI in wp-admin
  • Professional templates out of the box
  • Works with any WordPress theme
  • Focus on conversion and launch readiness
sections.installation:
1. Upload the awesome-coming-soon folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress.
  3. Open Awesome Coming Soon in wp-admin.
  4. Configure content, design, countdown, newsletter, and access settings.
  5. Save changes and enable coming soon mode.
sections.faq:
Is this a coming soon plugin or maintenance mode plugin?

Both. You can use it as a WordPress coming soon page plugin and as a maintenance mode plugin.

Can I use my own text and branding?

Yes. You can customize logo, heading, subheading, main message, colors, typography, footer text, and social links.

Can I show the normal website to logged-in users?

Yes. Use Access settings to allow logged-in users to bypass the coming soon page.

Does it support newsletter signup?

Yes. You can enable the newsletter form, customize form heading/description, and collect subscriber emails.

Does this plugin affect SEO?

You can configure title, meta description, and robots options in the SEO tab.

Is the plugin mobile responsive?

Yes. All templates are designed to work on desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

Can I preview templates before publishing?

Yes. You can preview templates and select the one that fits your launch campaign.

Does it work with WooCommerce or page builders?

Yes. The coming soon output is independent from normal theme/page builder rendering and can be used on WooCommerce sites as well.
